summary: A beginner task from Turael, Spria and Mazchna at 7 Slayer. Level 6 cave bugs in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves die to any combat style and drop low-level herbs; the caves need a light source and a rope, and wall beasts in the corridors can grab you unless you wear a spiny helmet or run past them. Level 96 cave bugs in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon can be safespotted but need Death to the Dorgeshuun. Both variants regenerate hitpoints about 20 times faster than normal monsters.
styleNotes: Both variants have a 50% elemental weakness to fire spells; not immune to cannon or thralls; hitpoints regenerate every 5 game ticks.
requiredItems: Bullseye lantern (lit) or another light source (Fire of Eternal Light removes the need)
Rope (first visit to Lumbridge Swamp Caves)
usefulItems: Spiny helmet or Slayer helmet (wall beasts)

summary: A low-level task at 10 Slayer usually done in the first chamber of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, right beside fairy ring AJR. Cave crawlers hit up to 3 but inflict a strong poison, so bring antipoison; low-Defence players can range or mage them from the rocks around the chamber walls. They can also be killed in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves or Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon, where a light source is needed and exposed light sources can explode. They regenerate 1 hitpoint every 5 ticks, so kill them quickly.
styleNotes: Standard variant has no listed elemental weakness; the icy variant in Ruins of Tapoyauik is 50% weak to fire spells; not immune to cannon or thralls; they poison for 8.
usefulItems: Bullseye lantern or other enclosed light source (Lumbridge Swamp Caves / Dorgesh-Kaan)

summary: Cave horrors are found only in the Mos Le'Harmless Cave and need 58 Slayer, Cabin Fever, a light source and either a witchwood icon or Protect from Melee, because their scream always deals 10% of your base Hitpoints. They use magic-based melee, so most players either pray melee in prayer gear or use a fast Ranged weapon such as a toxic blowpipe from the many safespots near the cave entrance. A cannon can be used and there is a well-known cannon placement near the entrance where targeted horrors get stuck on the wall. They are killed mainly for the black mask and hard clue scrolls; bring a herb sack, seed box and log basket for the frequent herb, seed and mahogany log drops.
styleNotes: Not weak to any melee style; 30% elemental weakness to fire spells; not immune to cannon or thralls; low hitpoints favour fast-firing Ranged weapons.
requiredItems: Bullseye lantern (lit) or another light source (Fire of Eternal Light removes the need)
usefulItems: Telekinetic Grab runes for looting from safespots

locations.name: Mos Le'Harmless Cave
requirements: Light source or Fire of Eternal Light

locations.notes: 70 spawns, all aggressive, alongside aggressive albino bats. Get there by Minigame Teleport to Trouble Brewing, Bill Teach from Port Phasmatys, a charter ship, or a Mos le'harmless teleport scroll. Safespots exist directly beside the entrance behind the Fire of Eternal Light and around the lake; the recommended cannon spot is at 3785,9460.

summary: Cave kraken live only in Kraken Cove and can only be attacked while on task; you must disturb a whirlpool to surface each one. Magic is the only reliable style because Ranged deals a seventh of its damage and melee cannot reach them, so use earth spells against their elemental weakness and Protect from Magic against their magic attacks. Their drops are poor apart from the uncharged trident, so most players kill the Kraken boss instead for the same task, using fishing explosives to start each fight quickly.
styleNotes: 50% elemental weakness to earth spells; Ranged deals 1/7 damage, melee including halberds deals no damage; immune to cannon and thralls; attacks are magic so they can be prayed against.
usefulItems: Earth spell runes or an earth staff
Prayer potions for Protect from Magic

summary: Crabs have no requirements and are the classic AFK training monsters: they sit disguised as rocks, emerge and attack when you stand beside them, and the common training crabs hit only 1 with crush, so no special gear is needed beyond crush-heavy armour at low levels. They go tolerant after 10 minutes, so you must walk away and come back to reset aggression. Sand crabs on the Hosidius coast and ammonite crabs on Fossil Island are the usual choices, but they cannot be targeted by a cannon; rock crabs north of Rellekka can be cannoned in multicombat. King Sand Crabs give the most Slayer XP but fight back, and Gemstone and hermit crabs do not count.
styleNotes: All crabs attack with crush and are 15-35% weak to earth spells; sand, ammonite and frost crabs are immune to cannon; swamp crabs resist melee and magic but have negative ranged defence; Frost Crabs are 100% weak to fire spells.
usefulItems: Food or armour with high crush defence at low combat levels
Dwarf multicannon (rock crabs and king sand crabs only)
Ring of wealth (auto-collects numulite from ammonite crabs)

locations.name: Hosidius - southern coast
locations.notes: Sand crabs give 60 Slayer XP. There is a bank chest in the centre of the beach and a nearby altar. Reach it from a Hosidius house portal, the Tithe Farm minigame teleport, the Lovakengj minecart 'Hosidius South' stop, or fairy ring AKR. Often crowded; the Avium Savannah coast in Varlamore is a quieter alternative.

evidence.multi: not stated (the Sand Crab page only notes that the Outer Fortis area is single-way)
evidence.cannon: 'The dwarf multicannon cannot be used against them.' (Sand Crab); Dwarf multicannon page: 'Sand crabs and Ammonite crabs will not be targeted at all, as it would disrupt other players training.'
evidence.requirements: not stated

locations.name: North of Rellekka
locations.displayName: North of Rellekka (Rock Crabs, cannonable multicombat)
locations.notes: Rock crabs give 50 Slayer XP and are not shown as yellow dots on the minimap. Reset aggression by walking halfway back to the Rellekka entrance or by entering and leaving the Keldagrim tunnel.

evidence.multi: 'Rock Crabs are a very common cannon target, due to their low attack and the multicombat areas they inhabit.' (Dwarf multicannon); Multicombat area list: 'The northern coast of the Fremennik Province'
evidence.cannon: 'Rock Crabs are a very common cannon target, due to their low attack and the multicombat areas they inhabit.' (Dwarf multicannon)
evidence.requirements: not stated

locations.name: Mushroom Forest
locations.notes: Ammonite crabs give 100 Slayer XP and have 100 hitpoints and level 1 in every other stat. Found in the Mushroom Forest, around the Fossil Island Volcano and in the northern Wyvern Cave.

evidence.multi: not stated
evidence.cannon: Ammonite Crab infobox immunecannon = Yes; Dwarf multicannon page: 'Sand crabs and Ammonite crabs will not be targeted at all, as it would disrupt other players training.'
evidence.requirements: Task page Monster Variants row 'Ammonite Crab | Fossil Island | Requires completion of Bone Voyage' (Slayer task/Crabs)

locations.name: Crabclaw Isle
requirements: 10,000 coins to Sandicrahb (half price with easy Kourend & Kebos Diary, free with medium)
locations.notes: 40 sand crabs on a small island south of the Hosidius coast, with several spots where three or four crabs surround one tile. Spots may be occupied.

evidence.multi: not stated
evidence.cannon: 'The dwarf multicannon cannot be used against them.' (Sand Crab)
evidence.requirements: 'Players can reach the island by paying Sandicrahb 10,000 coins. Completing the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary will allow players to access it for half the price. Completing the medium Kourend & Kebos Diary will allow players to access the island for free.' (Crabclaw Isle)

locations.name: Haunted Woods
locations.displayName: South of Port Phasmatys / Slepe path (Swamp Crabs, multicombat)
locations.notes: Swamp crabs give 75 Slayer XP, have a 1-square aggression range and resist melee and magic, so use Ranged. Lower-level players should stay near Port Phasmatys because the path through the Haunted Woods has feral vampyres and leeches.

evidence.multi: 'They can be found in multi-combat areas directly south of Port Phasmatys and along the path leading from Port Phasmatys to Slepe.' (Swamp Crab)
evidence.cannon: not stated (Swamp Crab infobox immunecannon = No, but no statement about placing a cannon in the Haunted Woods)
evidence.requirements: not stated

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.displayName: Catacombs of Kourend (King Sand Crabs, most Slayer XP)
locations.notes: King Sand Crabs (level 107) give 200 Slayer XP and can drop ancient shards, dark totem pieces and medium clues, but unlike other crabs they have real offensive and defensive stats. Also found in the Crabclaw Caves.

evidence.multi: 'As this particular dungeon is a multicombat area (excluding the brutal dragon area)' (Catacombs of Kourend)
evidence.cannon: 'dwarf multicannons cannot be placed inside the Catacombs' (Catacombs of Kourend); Dwarf multicannon prohibited list: Catacombs of Kourend
evidence.requirements: not stated

locations.name: Waterbirth Island
requirements: Boat with Jarvald at Rellekka: 1,000 coins per trip unless The Fremennik Trials is complete
locations.notes: Rock crabs are scattered across the island in their disguised rock form. Also reachable by Waterbirth Teleport (72 Magic, Lunar) or a house portal.

evidence.multi: not stated (the Multicombat area list names 'Waterbirth Island Dungeon' but not the island surface)
evidence.cannon: not stated (Waterbirth Island page has no cannon statement; not on the prohibited list)
evidence.requirements: 'Speak to Jarvald at the Rellekka docks to travel to the island via boat (the player does not have to start or complete The Fremennik Trials; costs 1,000 coins each time if the quest is not complete)' (Waterbirth Island)

locations.name: West of Mount Quidamortem
locations.notes: 28 rock crabs at the base of the mountain near the mountain troll settlements; aggressive lizardmen patrol the east side, so bring poison protection.

evidence.multi: not stated (the Mount Quidamortem page only calls the troll camp south of the peak multicombat)
evidence.cannon: not stated
evidence.requirements: 'At the base of the mountain will be some mountain troll settlements and a large group of rock crabs.' and monster list 'Rock crab (x28)' (Mount Quidamortem)

locations.name: Isle of Souls
locations.notes: Reach it through the Soul Wars portal near the Edgeville ruins, the portal in the Ferox Enclave Dungeon or the Soul Wars Minigame Teleport. The only bank is in the Soul Wars lobby.

evidence.multi: Isle of Souls: 'Apart from a small area in the north where there are a few [[bird]]s, the entire island is [[single-way combat]].'
evidence.cannon: Sand Crab infobox immunecannon = Yes; 'The dwarf multicannon cannot be used against them.' (Sand Crab)
evidence.requirements: 'The isle can be accessed through a few different means: Entering the Soul Wars Portal near the Edgeville ruins. Entering the Soul Wars Portal inside the Ferox Enclave Dungeon. Using the Soul Wars Minigame Teleport.' (Isle of Souls); Sand Crab LocLine 'Isle of Souls'

locations.name: Avium Savannah - southern coast
locations.displayName: Avium Savannah southern coast (Sand Crabs, quieter)
requirements: Children of the Sun (first travel to Civitas illa Fortis)
locations.notes: From Civitas illa Fortis go south to the beach and west to the sand crabs. Faces much less competition than the Hosidius crabs.

evidence.multi: not stated
evidence.cannon: Sand Crab infobox immunecannon = Yes; 'The dwarf multicannon cannot be used against them.' (Sand Crab)
evidence.requirements: 'The player must first travel to Civitas illa Fortis via Regulus Cento after completing Children of the Sun before other transportation methods become usable.' (Avium Savannah); 'A recommended alternative are the Sand Crabs on the Avium Savannah in Varlamore, which face much less competition compared to the Sand Crabs in Hosidius.' (Sand Crab)

locations.name: Crabclaw Caves
locations.displayName: Crabclaw Caves (Sand Crabs and King Sand Crabs)
requirements: Partial completion of The Depths of Despair
locations.notes: South of the Woodcutting Guild. One spot has three sand crabs together and another has four; two smaller caves hold several king sand crabs. A cannon can be set up but only targets the king sand crabs.

evidence.multi: not stated
evidence.cannon: 'You are able to set up a dwarf multicannon inside the cave to kill a king sand crab for the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary. The dwarf multicannon will not target immune targets such as sand crabs or sand snakes, however.' (Crabclaw Caves)
evidence.requirements: 'Access to the caves requires partial completion of The Depths of Despair quest.' (Crabclaw Caves)

locations.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
locations.displayName: Ruins of Tapoyauik middle and bottom floors (Frost Crabs)
requirements: The Heart of Darkness (task page says partial completion; the Ruins of Tapoyauik page says the ruins are not accessible before completing the quest)
locations.notes: Frost crabs give 60 Slayer XP and are 100% weak to fire spells. Cannon cannot be placed in the ruins and frost crabs are cannon-immune anyway.

evidence.multi: not stated
evidence.cannon: Frost Crab infobox immunecannon = Yes; 'A Dwarven multicannon cannot be placed inside the ruins.' (Ruins of Tapoyauik)
evidence.requirements: Task page Monster Variants row 'Frost Crab | Ruins of Tapoyauik | Requires partial completion of The Heart of Darkness' (Slayer task/Crabs); 'Prior to quest completion, they are not accessible.' (Ruins of Tapoyauik)

notes: Assigned by Mazchna (30-50), Vannaka (40-90) and Chaeldar (70-130) since 26 March 2025; not assignable by Konar. xpPerKill is null because it varies by variant: Crab 18-19, Rock Crab 50, Sand Crab 60, Frost Crab 60, Swamp Crab 75, Ammonite Crab 100, Giant Rock Crab 198, King Sand Crab 200. Gemstone Crabs and hermit crabs do not count. Mogre Camp crabs need partial Recipe for Disaster (Pirate Pete) and that camp cannot be cannoned; Giant Rock Crabs live in the Waterbirth Island Dungeon and Tonali Cavern. The Frost Crab quest requirement is recorded differently on the task page (partial) and the Ruins of Tapoyauik page (completed).
